Subject: Candidate: Celine Tran — availability for full loop (SF / remote)

Hi Jordan,

We have Celine Tran (ex-Terzo, senior SWE) ready for a full interview loop next week. She is currently available the week of Aug 25 and prefers afternoons Pacific. She is open to a hybrid virtual loop; timezone is PST.

Quick details:
- Role: Senior Software Engineer (compute infra)
- Preferred: 4–5 interviews + 45m system design
- Recruiter notes: strong systems background, limited on product questions

Can you run a quick feasibility check with your interview ops team and propose a slot plan? We prefer one afternoon (same day) with a 30m warmup/intro and an asynchronous debrief window. Celine can do 12:30–5:30 PT on Aug 27 or 12:30–6:00 PT on Aug 28.

Thanks — I can hold both dates tentatively for now.

— Priya Singh

recruit@talentbridge.io

Laura/Kim/Marissa —

Thanks Priya — Celine looks like a good fit for the compute team. Quick proposed plan for Aug 27 (preferred):

Agenda (single-day, hybrid / virtual-on-site):
- 12:30–1:00 PM PT: Candidate warmup + hiring manager intro (virtual) — Jordan (HM)
- 1:05–1:35 PM PT: Coding interview 1 (pairing) — Marissa
- 1:45–2:15 PM PT: Coding interview 2 — Tessa
- 2:30–3:15 PM PT: System design (45m) — Laura (principal SWE)
- 3:30–4:00 PM PT: Product / cross-functional (30m) — Kimberly
- 4:15–4:45 PM PT: Culture / bar-raising (30m) — backup: Jordan
- 5:00–5:30 PM PT: Async debrief buffer / scorer consolidation (Slack + scorecard)

Key asks:
- Laura: can you own design (45m)?
- Marissa & Tessa: are the pairing slots okay? We want contiguous blocks with short buffers to give candidate micro-breaks.
- Kimberly: product slot — happy to keep 30m. If you have a calendar conflict, who can cover?

We should include a 15m recovery buffer between major sessions to accommodate slight overruns. If any interviewer has a conflict, list a backup. I attached a quick itinerary and the scorecard template I'm proposing.

If Aug 27 is hard, fallback Aug 28 uses same cadence with start at 12:45.

Jordan
Director, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20250821-Celine-Tran-itinerary.pdf; panel-scorecard-template.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Candidate: Celine Tran — availability for full loop (SF / remote)

Jordan —

Thanks for the outline. I can take the system design block at 2:30; 45m works. A couple of notes and one conflict:

- I have a standing meeting at 3:00–3:20 that day. To avoid chopping design, can we shift design to 2:15–3:00 and move product to 3:15–3:45? That preserves a 10–15m break.
- Kimberly is out for part of the afternoon (1:30–2:30) but can do 3:15–3:45. If we shuffle as above, that should be fine.
- Marissa confirmed 1:05–1:35; Tessa confirmed 1:45–2:15.

Backups: if Kimberly needs to drop, I can handle product high-level questions in 3:15–3:45 with a focus on trade-offs and cross-team impact. Also suggest pairing one interviewer as 'scribe' for each session to speed debriefs.

I updated the attached itinerary with the shifted times and added calendar links for Zoom + pairing pad. Also added a short pre-interview coaching note for Celine to set expectations (30m warmup).

Laura Bennett
Principal SWE, Compute
Redwood Inference
